<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Loading WordPress fires init, where the theme creates its pages and runs its content migrations.
// Theme Setup (non-forced, no media) seeds page meta, SEO defaults, the posts page and the blog posts.
if ( function_exists( 'restwell_run_theme_setup' ) ) {
	restwell_run_theme_setup();
}
// Local-only Outlook iCal link from .claude/playground-local/ical-feed-url.txt (gitignored).
$ical_file = '/wordpress/wp-content/playground-local/ical-feed-url.txt';
if ( is_readable( $ical_file ) && function_exists( 'restwell_occupancy_sanitize_feed_url' ) ) {
	$ical = restwell_occupancy_sanitize_feed_url( trim( (string) file_get_contents( $ical_file ) ) );
	if ( '' !== $ical ) {
		update_option( 'restwell_ical_feed_url', $ical, false );
		if ( defined( 'RESTWELL_OCCUPANCY_CACHE_KEY' ) ) {
			delete_transient( RESTWELL_OCCUPANCY_CACHE_KEY );
			// Prime the cache now; if the first fetch fails, drop the 15-minute failure so the next page load retries.
			if ( function_exists( 'restwell_get_occupancy_booked' ) ) {
				$primed = restwell_get_occupancy_booked();
				if ( empty( $primed['ok'] ) ) {
					delete_transient( RESTWELL_OCCUPANCY_CACHE_KEY );
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
$home = get_page_by_path( 'home', OBJECT, 'page' );
if ( $home ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $home->ID );
}
flush_rewrite_rules( false );
